apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 15 billing cycles on balance transfers completed within the first 90 days of account opening and for 12 billing cycles on purchases, then 18.49%, 21.49%, 23.49%, 26.49% or 28.49% variable APR based on creditworthiness.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee is 3% of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 2% cash back on all eligible purchases, with no rotating categories or caps.

signup_bonus.description: $200 cash back (20,000 bonus points) as a statement credit after spending $1,500 within the first 90 days after account opening.
